column1: # hw-panel (hw-qwen), 2026-10-15: four downloadable readers on the truth set's 19 handwritten and 2 mixed pages (HW-PAGES-2026-10-15.tsv), beside hw-measure's three (HW-MEASURE-2026-10-15.tsv, its rows copied below).

# Chat models read the whole page (the source JPEG) in the lab's venv (mlx-vlm 0.7.4) by ops/ocrlab/read-mlx.py, temperature 0, a process a page under ops/ocrlab/run-guarded.sh at 12 GB (the memory slider's top; ModelGuard's default cap is 5 GB).
# Kraken reads the line boxes Vision found on the bitmap production recognises (Flattener.flatten, then Recogniser.recognisePage(at:)), each as a baseline at 80% of its height.
# Scored exactly as hw-measure (its header): a bag of score-bakeoff.py tokens against the whole-page transcription, words holding [illegible] left out; added = reading words matching no truth word.
# The scorer reproduces HW-MEASURE's vision rows exactly from a fresh run. read_s: the model's own read, load (1.5-3.0 s) excluded; peak_mb: the guard's physical footprint (Kraken: /usr/bin/time's).
# THE BAR (handwritten): missed <= 204/1000 (half of Falcon-OCR's 409) and added <= 793 (Falcon-OCR's). Small sample, one archive's hands.
# hw-measure's three, through the app (handwritten missed/1000, added): vision 561, 1,189; paddleocr-vl 454, 906; falcon-ocr 409, 793.

# qwen3.5-9b-4bit: handwritten missed 91/1000, added 312; mixed 64, 18; read s a page median 31.8; peak footprint 8743 MB; download 5.98 GB. mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-4bit, read-mlx.py's default prompt, --max-side 2400 (Archive Suite's panel cap)

# lightonocr-3-4b-8bit: handwritten missed 96/1000, added 264; mixed 64, 21; read s a page median 17.8; peak footprint 7613 MB; download 5.16 GB. prithivMLmods/LightOnOCR-3-4B-MLX 8bit/, empty prompt, --max-side 2048 --max-tokens 4096 (the card's)

# lightonocr-3-4b-8bit-nara-prompt: handwritten missed 92/1000, added 359; mixed 59, 24; read s a page median 19.7; peak footprint 7621 MB; download 5.16 GB. the same build with wjbmattingly/nara-lightonocr-3-4b's prompt.txt

# churro-3b-8bit: handwritten missed 152/1000, added 6602; mixed 153, 45; read s a page median 23.1; peak footprint 6085 MB; download 4.63 GB. stanford-oval/churro-3B as the lab converted it to MLX 8-bit on 2026-10-07 (still on disk), --churro --max-side 1600; its Hub download is the bf16 source, 7.53 GB

# kraken-ppocrv6-medium: handwritten missed 666/1000, added 1277; mixed 317, 61; read s a page median 2.7; peak footprint 3791 MB; download 0.06 GB. small-models-for-glam/kraken-ppocrv6-medium, kraken 7.1.1 in its own venv (1.2 GB with torch), on production's Vision line boxes, one process a page
# Result: Qwen3.5-9B and LightOnOCR-3-4B pass. Churro 3B misses 152 but adds 6,602 (p096 ran to 12,000 tokens, a loop): fails. Kraken misses 666, more than Vision's 561 on the same lines: fails.

# Pick: LightOnOCR-3-4B, empty prompt. 96 against Qwen's 91 is within 20, so the smaller and faster wins (Kraken, preferred there, failed): 5.16 against 5.98 GB, a median 17.8 against 31.8 s a page, fewer added words; peak 7,613 against 8,743 MB.
